The '''Droid Abolitionist Movement''' was a fanatical group of individuals that promoted [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid rights/Legends|rights]]. Led by [[Xalto Sneerzick]], the group petitioned that droids be freed from servitude and be granted the rights of all [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. The movement reached its height when its members led an attack on [[Cosmohaul Shipping]] seeking to free its droids. The coalition collapsed, however, when the group of frightened droids [[Death/Legends|killed]] the entire group.<ref name="AJ9" />
